from jobs import unique_jobs


def test_stable_first_occurrence_wins_by_source_and_id():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '2', 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'b', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 3
    assert out[0] is rows[0]
    assert out[1] is rows[2]
    assert out[2] is rows[3]


def test_no_merge_across_sources():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'same'},
        {'source': 'b', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'same'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 2


def test_missing_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': None, 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 'x'},
    ]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 3


def test_input_not_mutated():
    rows = [
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'},
        {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'},
    ]
    snapshot = [dict(r) for r in rows]
    unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == snapshot


def test_empty_input():
    assert unique_jobs([]) == []


def test_missing_source_key():
    rows = [{'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'}, {'source_id': '1', 'title': 'x'}]
    out = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(out) == 1
